रुह् {c1c} P. (रोहति, रुरोह, अरुक्षत्,
रोक्ष्यति, रोढुं, रूढ)
1 To grow, spring
up, shoot forth, germinate;
रूढरागप्रवालः

.
--2 To grow up, be developed,
increase.
--3 To rise, mount upwards,
ascend.
--4 To grow over, heal up
(as a wound); रोहते सायकैर्विद्धं न
संरोहति वाक्क्षतं

.
--5 To
reach to, attain. --Caus. (रोपयति-ते,
रोहयति-ते)
1 To cause to grow,
[]
plant, put in the ground.
--2 To
raise up, elevate.
--3 To entrust,
devolve upon, commit to the care of;
गुणवत्सुतरोपितश्रियः

.
--5 To fix, fasten. --Desid.
(रुरुक्षति) To wish to grow &c.

रुह्, रुह a. (At the end of comp.)
Growing or produced in; as in
महीरुह्, पंकेरुह &c.
